references.text: The Lord predicts that He will harden Pharaoh's heart so that he will not let the people go.
The Lord says that He will harden Pharaoh's heart and perform many signs and wonders in Egypt.
Pharaoh's heart was hardened, and he did not listen to Moses and Aaron, just as the Lord had said.
The Lord hardened Pharaoh's heart, and he did not listen to them, just as the Lord had told Moses.
Pharaoh's heart was hardened, and he would not let the Israelites go, just as the Lord had said through Moses.
The Lord hardened Pharaoh's heart so that he did not let the Israelites go.
The Lord hardened Pharaoh's heart, and he refused to let them go.
The Lord hardened Pharaoh's heart, and he pursued the Israelites after they had gone out.
The Lord hardened King Sihon's spirit and made his heart stubborn in order to give him into Israel's hand.
It was the Lord who hardened their hearts so that they went out to war against Israel.
Paul quotes Scripture about Pharaoh and explains that God hardens whom He wills, as an example of God's sovereign will.
